name: Aalto University
summary: Technology, business and design university in Espoo; 11 English bachelor's options, each admitting you to a bachelor's and a master's.

ib.text: IB applicants go in admission round B, ranked on IB grades with national scoring tables. HL and SL score the same; engineering options need advanced maths at 6. No English test needed.

dates.label: Round B (IB) results published at the latest
Final IB grades due and deadline to accept your place, 15:00

programmes.name: Design and Media
programmes.ib: IB grades do not count: preliminary assignments, intake assignments and an interview decide.

programmes.name: Economics
programmes.ib: Economics scoring table; advanced maths at 2 or basic maths at 4.

programmes.name: Finance
programmes.ib: Economics scoring table; advanced maths at 2 or basic maths at 4. SAT/ACT is an optional second route.

programmes.name: International Business
programmes.ib: Business scoring table; any maths at grade 2. SAT/ACT is an optional second route.

programmes.name: Chemical Engineering
programmes.ib: Advanced maths (AA SL/HL or AI HL) at grade 6.

programmes.name: Computer Engineering
programmes.ib: Advanced maths (AA SL/HL or AI HL) at grade 6.

programmes.name: Data Science
programmes.ib: Advanced maths (AA SL/HL or AI HL) at grade 6.

programmes.name: Digital Systems and Design
programmes.ib: Advanced maths (AA SL/HL or AI HL) at grade 6.

programmes.name: Mechanical and Civil Engineering
programmes.ib: Advanced maths (AA SL/HL or AI HL) at grade 6.

programmes.name: Quantum Technology
programmes.ib: Advanced maths or physics at grade 6.

programmes.name: Technology, Business and Design
programmes.ib: Advanced maths at grade 6 plus a passed preliminary assignment, published 17 December 2026.

notes: Aalto runs its own application on Studyinfo, not the national joint application, so its window closes on 22 January 2027 rather than the 21st.
You can choose at most three study options in one round, and you are admitted to only one.
Every bachelor's place comes with the right to continue to a named Aalto master's, so you are admitted to a 3+2 year path.
